focal_rule: All documented country histories in the 90-market universe, including collective waves; independent choices are separately estimated. Missing histories are not invented.
peer_histories: May include documented countries outside the focal market universe. All adoption shares use t-1; learning uses prior adopters before t-1.
benchmarked_success: Fixed-cohort country changes from current liquidity rerun; excludes focal country and shared assignment clusters from controls.
calendar_limit: Recorded implementation phases; not certified earliest adoption or real-time-vintage macro data.
